headline: Kanlaon Volcano Erupts, Sends Up Dark Ash Plume
captionCards: Dianne Paula Abendan video for Daily Guardian
instagramCaption:
Dark ash erupted into the air from Kanlaon Volcano on Saturday, Oct. 10.

Video captured between 12:45 p.m. and 12:48 p.m. shows the plume rising during the event. Dianne Paula Abendan recorded the footage for Daily Guardian.

This eruption highlights the ongoing volcanic activity in the region.
